# SOP – Start of Pakistan

> SOP is an eCommerce and AI company based in Jhelum, Pakistan. We run Amazon seller accounts, manage Amazon PPC, build Shopify stores and custom websites, and design AI automation for brands selling in the UK and US.

## What we do

- Amazon account management: listings, optimisation, inventory, customer service, account health and Brand Registry, handled end to end.
- Amazon PPC management: campaign structure, keyword research, bid management, negative keywords, budget pacing and weekly reporting. Fixed monthly fee, no percentage of ad spend.
- Shopify stores: store design, product catalogue and checkout setup, plus ongoing maintenance.
- Custom websites: hand-coded and WordPress/WooCommerce storefronts.
- AI automation: AI agents for content, customer support and repetitive operations.

## Who we serve

Amazon and Shopify sellers in the United Kingdom and the United States. We work to the client's time zone from Jhelum, Pakistan.

## Location

Rizwan Heights, Satellite Town, Jhelum 49600, Pakistan.
